cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(portfolio_forge_toolchain LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib)
file(GLOB COMPILER compiler/*.c)
file(GLOB STANDARD stdlib/*.c)
file(GLOB RUNTIME runtime/*.c)
list(REMOVE_ITEM RUNTIME ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/arena.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/platform.c)
add_executable(forge ${COMPILER} runtime/platform.c)
target_include_directories(forge PRIVATE include compiler)
add_library(forge_std STATIC ${STANDARD} runtime/arena.c)
target_include_directories(forge_std PUBLIC include)
add_library(forge_runtime STATIC ${RUNTIME} runtime/platform.c)
target_include_directories(forge_runtime PUBLIC include runtime)
target_link_libraries(forge_runtime PUBLIC forge_std pthread m)
